title: AWS Budgets disables Batch queue on spend threshold
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Spend guardrails
  Scenario: Daily budget exceeded disables Batch
    Given AWS Budgets is configured with a daily threshold
    When the budget alert fires
    Then an EventBridge-triggered Lambda disables the Batch job queue
    And operators can still use the CLI kill-switch manually
```

## Implementation brief
1. Budgets + SNS + EventBridge + budget_guard Lambda in CDK.
2. Per-site-key quotas in router.
3. auritus killswitch command.
right_now_summary: AWS Budgets will disable the Batch queue when daily spending exceeds the threshold.
